settings.heading: Questions, answered clearly.
settings.introduction: Product choices, customization and order help, with the details that still need confirmation made clear.

settings.heading: How do I choose the right phone model?
settings.text: Select the exact phone model on the product page and check its availability. Similar device names do not guarantee the same fit. Contact us if you are unsure.

settings.heading: Are the listed case materials and features verified?
settings.text: The current Signature Clear listing is a demonstration product. Its configured case-type names are not proof of tested material, magnetic compatibility, protection or fit. These details still require confirmation.

settings.heading: How do I personalize a design?
settings.text: Choose the available case and model options, enter a name, then explore the font, colour, position and size controls. Review the complete design before continuing. Read the customization guide.

settings.heading: What name length does the current customizer accept?
settings.text: The existing name field allows up to 20 characters. It offers six fonts. Check the preview for your exact spelling; character support and final production limits are not yet verified.

settings.heading: Does the preview show an exact print size?
settings.text: No. The placement and size controls are existing design-preview settings, not verified physical print dimensions. Contact us to clarify production requirements before ordering.

settings.heading: Where can I confirm production and delivery details?
settings.text: Read the current shipping information and any delivery information shown at checkout. If the production time, destination or delivery timing you need is not stated, contact us before ordering. No delivery date is promised by this preview.

settings.heading: How can I check an existing order?
settings.text: Use the order-status link in your order confirmation email or the existing account order history. See the order help page.

settings.heading: Where can I check return eligibility?
settings.text: Review the store’s published refund policy before ordering. If it does not answer your question about a personalized item, contact us for clarification. This guide does not add or change return conditions.

settings.heading: How do I contact Lumasela?
settings.text: Use the existing contact form. For an order question, include your order number and describe the issue. For a product question, include your phone model and the product you are considering.
